title: Auth token
description: The time-limited credential the authentication endpoint returns, and the record it validates against later.

user.description: Who the token belongs to, as the configured backend named them.

token.description: The opaque credential itself. Every other surface accepts this string.

ttl.description: Requested lifespan in seconds. Supplied by the caller; the response states the resulting expiry instead.

expiry.description: When the token stops being accepted.

metadata.description: Free mapping, empty in the ordinary case. Nothing about permissions is carried here — they are evaluated per request against the user.
